selection_source: FF01/12 related comparisons recorded after 330 review, historical data, 330 hindsight comparisons and prior fair-model inspection, before formal audit; not blind, prospective or preregistered
ideal_model_scope: Six distinct numbers sampled uniformly without replacement from 49; current target mapping assumed; independent of past. Exact counts only within this hypothetical mechanism, NOT actual success, forecast, price or return.
display_definition: Each named sign must appear among the inferred normal six to complete a column. Seventh and reserve do not count.

identical_model_explanation: Horse is an isolated 5-number single; the shared A and B/C/D are four different 4-number groups in both designs. Permuting equal-sized groups leaves the uniform model event distribution unchanged; this does not establish actual forecasting equality.
repeat_caveat: 330 has 5 distinct previous normal identities and 6 seven-ball identities. Full FF01 columns require repeat 3 or 4 among normal six, which is necessary not sufficient; zero repeat forces zero complete columns and all five repeats force single and pair but not triple.
